title: Affine torsion comparison for a Cartier-factor blow-up chart
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $I\subseteq A$ be an ideal, let $a\in I$, let $x\in A$ be a nonzerodivisor, and let $M$ be an $A$-module with $\Gamma_{(x)}(M)=0$. Put $B=A[I/a]$, the affine blow-up chart algebra [def-nagata-blowup-chart-ring], and regard $a$ and $xa$ as elements of $B$ through $A\to B$. Then the power-torsion submodules agree:

$$\Gamma_{(a)}(M\otimes_A B)=\Gamma_{(xa)}(M\otimes_A B).$$

Here $\Gamma_{(r)}$ is the submodule of elements killed by some positive power of $r$ [def-nagata-power-torsion].
